question: To whom is salutation offered as the ground of all wondrous origination?
premises: Salutation is directed to a specific recipient.
The recipient is the abode of all wondrous origination.
The recipient is characterized as the unequal-eyed one.
inference: Reverence is offered to Śiva as the unequal-eyed source of all wonders.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of viṣama-cakṣus as three-eyed or odd-eyed is context-dependent.
plain_english: Salutation to the unequal-eyed one, the ground from which all wonders arise.
